cases.rationale: C# retains number annotations for first and second in an assigned fallback function (|| or ??). Go stops host discovery at the logical operator and loses those annotations. TypeScript6.0.3 checker independently resolves both parameter types to number.

cases.name: tsc/testdata/tests/cases/compiler/jsEnumCrossFileExport.ts::0
cases.rationale: Both compilers reject the same unnamed typedef with identical diagnostic code and span. JavaScript lexical syntax is valid, so the independent JavaScript parse-diagnostic gate is inapplicable to this documentation-declaration error. Source declarations and annotated types survive; recovery metadata and documentation namespace spans differ.
